verdict.rationale: A live probe returned HTTP 200 for https://docs.coreweave.com/llms.txt, which serves a structured markdown index titled 'CoreWeave Docs'. The docs pages themselves are published as .md URLs (e.g. cks.md, terraform.md), so an agent can be pointed directly at machine-readable documentation. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing or promoting the llms.txt / agent-oriented docs, evidence of full-content variants (e.g. llms-full.txt) or index completeness, and independent corroboration of agents using it.
